Class DemographicMetricsHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.metrics.DemographicMetricsHelper
public final class DemographicMetricsHelper extends Object

DemographicMetricsHelper

Calculates structural demographic metrics, dependency ratios, migration pressures, carrying capacity buffers, and endogenous urbanization rates (Peter Turchin, Jack Goldstone, Thomas Malthus, Paul Bairoch).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • computeCellUrbanFraction

      public static double computeCellUrbanFraction(double pop, double kpc, double powerW, double cellAreaKm2)
      Evaluates local cellular urbanization fraction in $[0.0, 0.92]$ from population agglomeration, areal density, physical capital per capita, and useful mechanical/thermal power per capita (Bairoch 1988; de Vries 1984). Enforces smooth zero urbanization ($invalid input: '<' 0.01\%$) in Paleolithic foraging regimes.
      Parameters:
      pop - cellular living human population count
      kpc - physical capital per capita ($\text{kg/person}$)
      powerW - useful power per capita ($\text{W/person}$)
      cellAreaKm2 - hexagonal cell surface area ($\text{km}^2$)
      Returns:
      urbanized fraction in $[0.0, 0.92]$
